title: Karnataka High Court (Justice M. Nagaprasanna, WP 16078/2026) refuses to quash the SFIO's criminal case against Razorpay directors Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar (accused Nos. 8 and 9); the SFIO says about ₹320 crore of MENTPL's payments passed through Razorpay and alleges KYC and transaction-monitoring lapses; trial pending in Bengaluru; Razorpay itself not a party; Razorpay's ₹5,000-6,000 crore IPO reportedly cleared by SEBI (~$5 billion valuation)
